However, the lack of context and detailed clinical history makes it challenging to definitively rule out other conditions such as Tinea Capitis or Lichen Planopilaris. Further diagnostic tests, such as fungal culture for Tinea Capitis and histopathological examination to rule out lichen planus, are recommended. agent conservative fusion: kept the agent diagnosis.
